title: PICKUP ROWS SAY WHERE IT WENT
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like a shooter HUD, one short callout per thing. A gun into the free slot said SHOTGUN STOWED with PRESS 2 TO SWAP under it, a gun into his hands said its name equipped with a damage figure, a gun or a Stim on a belt key said SHOTGUN ON KEY 3, and a full belt said GUN SLOTS FULL: each a second line about an item already in the pickup stack, waiting behind the first and pushing other lines off. Where it went is now the dim caps tag on the item row in the pickup stack: SLOT 2 (the slot is the key that swaps to it), IN HAND, or BACKPACK when no key was free. Nothing else is said for it.
now: A pickup row says where the item went: SLOT 2, IN HAND or BACKPACK.
